summary: Practise customs-file checks, HS classification and freight-document control. Explore clearing and forwarding training and its practical outcomes.
lede: Clearing and forwarding training covers preparing shipment files, classifying goods with the Harmonized System, and coordinating cargo clearance. For clearing agents, freight coordinators and documentation staff, it builds practical skills in checking invoices, packing lists and transport records, reviewing valuation and origin details, and reporting file gaps and release actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people handling customs entries, freight files, cargo release coordination or client updates. It suits entry-level and developing practitioners who want a structured approach to shipping documents and clearance workflows.
prerequisites: No coding or specialist software is required. Familiarity with shipping paperwork is useful but not essential.
